baseline_adapters.beast_capability_composition_rule_engine: Uses the existing CapabilityCompositionPlane as a no-provider rule/composition competitor.
baseline_adapters.beast_generation_provider_boundary: Uses the existing generation provider adapter boundary in deterministic no-network stub mode.
baseline_adapters.beast_local_semantic_cache: Uses the existing LocalSemanticCache lexical/dense-cache implementation against historical exemplars.
baseline_adapters.beast_topology_graph_adapter: Uses an in-repo topology graph walk over dependency/route facts while ignoring policy and freshness.
baseline_adapters.cached_named_template: Replays only named-scenario templates; held-out names miss.
baseline_adapters.external_rag_retrieval: Calls an operator-supplied external RAG command with public scenario JSON and scores its answer/chunks against the independent oracle.
baseline_adapters.knowledge_graph_topology_only: Uses topology reachability and ignores policy/temporal/capacity gates.
baseline_adapters.model_generated_multimodal_stub: Simulates provider multimodal answer with unverified text/SVG and provider cost.
baseline_adapters.rag_nearest_exemplar: Retrieves a nearest named exemplar answer/diagram without proof custody.
baseline_adapters.rule_engine_text_only: Computes text from rules but emits no proof-bound visual artifact.

claim_boundary: Reference external-breakthrough benchmark scaffold. Held-out cases are generated after engine freeze from an evaluator seed. Semantic scoring uses an independent oracle derived only from scenario facts, policies, rules, topology metadata, and temporal flags before BEAST execution. Baseline adapters are transparent local references and should be replaced by independent public implementations for third-party claims.

third_party_verifier.baseline_adapter_contract: external systems may submit answer_text, visual_present or visual_bytes, reported_status, reported_class, reported_current_claim_allowed, provider_calls_used
third_party_verifier.evaluator_seed_contract: chosen after freeze; appears in generator_seed_digest
third_party_verifier.external_rag_protocol: benchmark sends one c4x_external_rag_request JSON object on stdin per case; command returns benchmark output JSON or retrieval chunks JSON on stdout
third_party_verifier.semantic_oracle_contract: must derive expected status/class from scenario facts before reading any system answer
